issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) has inconsistent return types: the problem statement/UML specifies it should return a double for financial precision, but the provided solution implements it as `public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)`. This can cause student implementations/tests to fail due to signature mismatch and contradicts the stated precision requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts by changing the solution method signature to `public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and returning a double (e.g., accumulate in double or cast ingredient prices to double). Update any dependent code/tests accordingly.

issues.description: The specification contradicts itself about SealSaloon.stock: Part 1 text requires the field to be a non-static `final Stock` per instance, but later explicitly states the `stock` attribute must be static (shared across instances). The solution implements `private static final Stock stock`, which conflicts with the earlier per-instance requirement and can mislead students about intended object design.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the requirements consistent by choosing one design: either (1) declare in the text/UML that `stock` is `static final` (shared), or (2) remove the static requirement and implement `private final Stock stock` per SealSaloon instance, adjusting tests accordingly.
